limitations: Every original was individually opened at original detail, not inferred from a montage or hash equality.
Top-left dark navigation is visually dim; phone diagram labels are very small/soft. No numeric contrast conformance was measured.
The ring arrangement does not explicitly map its generic labels to Sleep, Measure and Transmit, and the reassembled ending does not geometrically distinguish measured current from an observed run.
Only sampled rests and control before/after pairs are reviewed, not continuous/reverse motion, full source/lifecycle integrity, other alternatives, final look selection or author acceptance.
No browser, model, test or application runtime was launched by this reviewer.
